DomainData.MainInfoText: Your privacy is important. You can choose your cookies below. You can modify your preferences at any time.
DomainData.AboutText: Learn more at our privacy and cookie statement.​
DomainData.AlertNoticeText:
On our home page www.ikea.com and our web pages on www.ikea.com/global/en/, we use cookies and similar techniques. Functional cookies for essential website functionality are always active. They also remember your language and country and allow you to view videos.

You may accept analytical cookies. These help us improve our website by collecting data on performance, geolocation and interactions. For this, we use unique identifiers like your IP address and share your data with 2 partners (Vimeo, Google). By clicking accept, you consent to all cookies and related data processing. To change your settings or withdraw consent, go to cookie settings.

Cookie choices only apply to the specified websites. Links may lead to other IKEA sites, including country websites owned by our franchisees. These sites have separate privacy and cookie statements. Check these individually.

Learn more in our privacy and cookie statement.

DomainData.BannerTitle: Hej! You are in control of your cookies.

Groups.GroupDescription: Functional cookies help to ensure functionality of our websites by enabling basic functions like page navigation and language preferences.
Groups.GroupDescriptionOTT: Functional cookies help to ensure functionality of our websites by enabling basic functions like page navigation and language preferences.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: kitchen-matchmaker
FirstPartyCookies.description: This local storage item is set and used by the kitchen matchmaker page to determine which page the user should be redirected to after completing the quiz on the page. Local storage duration can be changed by clearing the browser cache.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: interIkeaConsent
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie is set after visitors have seen a cookie information notice and in some cases only when they actively close the notice down.  It enables the website not to show the message more than once to a user.  The cookie has a one year lifespan and contains no personal information.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: OptanonConsent
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie is set by the cookie compliance solution from OneTrust. It stores information about the categories of cookies the site uses and whether visitors have given or withdrawn consent for the use of each category. This enables site owners to prevent cookies in each category from being set in the users browser, when consent is not given. The cookie has a normal lifespan of one year, so that returning visitors to the site will have their preferences remembered. It contains no information that can identify the site visitor.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: __cf_bm
FirstPartyCookies.description: The __cf_bm cookie is associated with Cloudflare Bot Management, and helps to identify and mitigate bots to protect our websites from malicious activity. The cookie distinguishes between human users and automated bots, typically expires in 30 minutes, and does not track users across different sites.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: LOCAL_ISO_STORAGE_KEY
FirstPartyCookies.description: This local storage item is initially set by a geolocation lookup and is used to set the accurate online store in the go shopping and call to action links on the web pages. It is only updated if the user selects a different online store in the region selectors. Local storage duration can be changed by clearing the browser cache.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: OptanonAlertBoxClosed
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie is set by websites using certain versions of the cookie law compliance solution from OneTrust.  It is set after visitors have seen a cookie information notice and in some cases only when they actively close the notice down.  It enables the website not to show the message more than once to a user.  The cookie has a one year lifespan and contains no personal information.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: LOCAL_LANGUAGE_STORAGE_KEY
FirstPartyCookies.description: This local storage item is initially set by the browser's language settings and is used to set the accurate online store in the go shopping and call to action links on the web pages. It is only updated if the user selects a different online store in the region selectors. Local storage duration can be changed by clearing the browser cache.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: _cfuvid
FirstPartyCookies.description: The _cfuvid cookie is used by Cloudflare to distinguish individual users who share the same IP address for the purpose of enforcing rate limiting rules.

Groups.GroupDescription: With these we and our partners gather data about website performance, visitor numbers, geolocation, and interactions, using unique identifiers such as IP address.
Groups.GroupDescriptionOTT: With these we and our partners gather data about website performance, visitor numbers, geolocation, and interactions, using unique identifiers such as IP address.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: _ga_xxxxxxxxxx
FirstPartyCookies.description: Used by Google Analytics to identify and track an individual session with your device.
FirstPartyCookies.thirdPartyDescription: Used by Google Analytics to identify and track an individual session with your device.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: __cf_bm
FirstPartyCookies.description: Episod is using the necessary __cf_bm cookie to support Cloudflare Bot Management. As part of our bot management service, this cookie helps manage incoming traffic that matches criteria associated with bots.
FirstPartyCookies.thirdPartyDescription:
The __cf_bm cookie is a cookie necessary to support Cloudflare Bot Management, currently in private beta. As part of our bot management service, this cookie helps manage incoming traffic that matches criteria associated with bots.
This is a CloudFoundry cookie.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: episod_id
FirstPartyCookies.description: The episod_id cookie is set when a person visits the website for the first time, if he/she has agreed to the cookie. IKEA Analytics sends the customer ID with each hit to associate the hits with a customer (browser). The cookie expires after 13 months and is reset so that a customer is considered a new customer every 13 months.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: episod_session_id
FirstPartyCookies.description: The episod_session_id cookie is set when a person visits the website for the first time, if the person has agreed to the cookie. The cookie gets the same expiry date as the main episod_id cookie and is updated after 30 min of inactivity.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: _ga
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie name is associated with Google Universal Analytics - which is a significant update to Google's more commonly used analytics service. This cookie is used to distinguish unique users by assigning a randomly generated number as a client identifier. It is included in each page request in a site and used to calculate visitor, session and campaign data for the sites analytics reports.  By default it is set to expire after 2 years, although this is customisable by website owners.

Groups.GroupDescription: We and our partners use these cookies to track visitors across websites with the purpose to display advertisements tailored to your interests so that they are as relevant to you as possible. For this we use unique identifiers such as your IP address, your computer and internet and system administration.
Groups.GroupDescriptionOTT: We and our partners use these cookies to track visitors across websites with the purpose to display advertisements tailored to your interests so that they are as relevant to you as possible. Groups.GroupDescription: Preference cookies enable a website to remember information that changes the way the website behaves or looks, like your preferred language or the region that you are in.
Groups.GroupDescriptionOTT: Preference cookies enable a website to remember information that changes the way the website behaves or looks, like your preferred language or the region that you are in.

Groups.GroupDescription: These cookies are set by a range of social media services that we have added to the site to enable you to share our content with your friends and networks. They are capable of tracking your browser across other sites and building up a profile of your interests. This may impact the content and messages you see on other websites you visit.    If you do not allow these cookies you may not be able to use or see these sharing tools.
